baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'they say / glory / our Lord ... our Lord' at words 1-3 and 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: Articulated speech externalizes recognition; transcendence-language clears the Lord of defect; the repeated possessive Lordship encloses both speaker and promise within acknowledged sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Voiced articulation makes the recognition a public speech-act rather than an unexpressed response.
Absolving and distancing from defect makes the utterance deny any failure in the Lord.
Mastery and sovereignty, repeated around the clause, identify whose governance the fulfilled promise displays.

changed_reading.before: They verbally praise God after recognizing a true promise.
changed_reading.after: Their voiced testimony absolves their Lord of failed sovereignty precisely as the promise is recognized in effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic construction 'indeed the promise of our Lord was surely made-done' at words 4-8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal presence, committed saying, and action reaching an object form a transition from pledged word to effected reality; the emphatic lām presents that transition as secured.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time locate the promise's realization as an event, not only an idea.
A commitment that opens expectancy supplies the prior pledged word whose realization is at issue.
The production of an act, carried by the passive-result form, marks the promise as having reached effect.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's promise was reliable in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Reliability is rendered as a passage from committed speech into an event whose promised object bears the action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of 'promise,' doubled 'our Lord,' temporal 'was,' and result-form 'made-done.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The promise can carry its own appointment while Lordship supplies cultivation and completion; fulfillment is therefore a governed maturation toward a due time, not an arbitrary intervention.

activation_trace.role: A promise bounded by an appointed time or place gives realization an intrinsic due point.
Repair, nurture, and completion make doubled Lordship the agency that brings the appointment to maturity.
Temporal occurrence supplies the moment at which the matured appointment becomes present.
Produced action supplies the completed endpoint of the governed process.

changed_reading.before: One undifferentiated future event has simply happened.
changed_reading.after: An appointed commitment has matured under completing Lordship until its due effect becomes present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial built from bones and fragments is answered by rousing, creating anew, and effective capacity; these cues give the focus promise a material object on which action lands.

activation_trace.role: The committed word supplies the promise whose concrete scope is sharpened by the preceding dispute.
Action reaching effect anchors the changed reading in the focus result-form.
Rousing what lies still turns inert remains into the starting state of renewed motion.
Creative origination supplies the causal step from remains to a newly effected creature.
New occurrence after a break marks discontinuity without blocking renewed creation.
Effective capacity able to reach action answers the objection that disintegrated matter cannot be acted upon.

structural_cues: 17:98 frames the objection with bones and pulverized remains becoming a new creation; 17:99 answers from creation of heavens and earth and a fixed term without doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inert remains, new creation, and capacity reaching action; I infer that they specify a concrete object of the focus promise. A live alternative is that the focus promise remains broader than resurrection and includes judgment as a whole.

changed_reading.before: The fulfilled promise is an unspecified future assurance.
changed_reading.after: Its efficacy is materially testable: even broken remains can become the acted-upon matter of renewed creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human possession turns mercy into guarded stock, fear of outflow, and constriction; against that economy, doubled Lordship plus a promise reaching effect reads as administration that does not imprison its pledged gift.

activation_trace.role: Nurturing and completing care anchors release and completion in the Lord named twice by the speakers.
Committed expectancy supplies what must pass from pledge to beneficiary rather than remain stored.
Produced effect marks the opposite of a promise held back as unused stock.
Guarding and securing stock supplies the closed-container side of the contrast.
Tender mercy identifies what human custodians would convert into guarded inventory.
Withholding wealth from stinginess supplies the blockage that divine completion reverses.
Money passing outward in expenditure supplies the feared release or transfer.
Constriction and reduction name the human economy against which fulfilled Lordship is read.

structural_cues: 17:100 imagines humans owning the treasuries of the Lord's mercy, then withholding for fear of expenditure and closes by naming the human being constrictive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy-as-treasury, human withholding, feared outflow, and constriction; I infer that a Lordly promise becoming effect is their inverse, an unblocked administration. The live alternative is that 17:100 diagnoses only human scarcity and does not directly characterize the promise as mercy.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment demonstrates power and reliability only.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment also appears as non-hoarding governance: what the Lord pledges is allowed to leave reserve and arrive as effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: A ruler tries to shake a people loose from land, but removal rebounds upon him; settlement then runs toward a final appointment at which scattered or mixed people are brought together. The focus passive result condenses this reversal-and-gathering sequence.

activation_trace.role: Action reaching its object anchors the historical sequence in the focus's result-form.
A lightness that destabilizes fixity supplies Pharaoh's intended displacement of the people.
Killing by submersion supplies the reversal in which the would-be displacer is removed.
An appointment bounded by time gives the final promise a due arrival rather than vague futurity.
Bringing and making present supplies the active collection that follows the appointment's arrival.
Different elements wrapped into one group give the brought people a gathered, mixed configuration.

structural_cues: 17:103 moves from intended expulsion to drowning; 17:104 moves from commanded settlement to the coming of the final promise and collective bringing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted destabilization, its reversal, settlement, a final appointment, and mixed gathering; I infer that this sequence is a historical mechanism compressed by 'surely made-done.' A live alternative is that the focus points only to the final gathering, not to a repeatable reversal pattern.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a single endpoint detached from prior history.
changed_reading.after: Its enactment carries a recognizable reversal: coercive displacement recoils, while the displaced are settled and finally gathered at the appointed time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth is delivered by descent, divided for recitation, and held in patient intervals; this turns fulfillment from a punctual switch into a sequence whose staged arrivals are already real effects.

activation_trace.role: A temporally bounded appointment anchors stages to an eventual due point.
Produced action lets each delivered stage count as real enactment rather than mere postponement.
Stable correspondence to reality frames both sending and arrival as truth-bearing events.
Descent and arrival supply directed movement from source into present reception.
Reading and recitation make delivery recurrently present in voiced reception.
Distribution into parts supplies the segmentation of one truth across successive units.
Steadiness with waiting gives the segmented delivery its paced temporal mechanism.
Caused descent and conveyance make the successive parts arrive rather than remain remote.

structural_cues: 17:105 repeats truth around sending and descent; 17:106 combines division, recitation, waiting, intensive sending, and a verbal noun of descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reality-correspondence, delivery, segmentation, recitation, and waiting; I infer that promise-fulfillment may be distributed across true stages. The live alternative is that the focus perfective emphasizes certainty of one endpoint while the preceding gradualism concerns only revelation.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment occurs only when one final event switches from future to complete.
changed_reading.after: The appointment can be fulfilled processually: paced, delivered stages are genuine effects while still moving toward a due completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window first presents faces without sight, blocked speech, and absent hearing; it later stages knowledgeable reception, faces falling, the focus utterance, renewed falling, tears, and increased humility. Saying becomes the audible hinge of a whole-body reversal.

activation_trace.role: Audible articulation anchors the bodily sequence in the focus verb of saying.
Praise as worship makes the articulated response an enacted devotion rather than commentary.
Loss of sight supplies the closed visual state reversed by responsive faces and tears.
Blocked speech supplies the direct negative counterpart to 'they say.'
Loss of hearing and non-attention supply the negative counterpart to receptive recitation.
A sounding, unsettled fall gives bodily momentum into the focus utterance.
Lowering and submission specify the fall as devotional abasement.
The repeated sounding fall carries bodily momentum out of the focus utterance.
Tears, grief, and voice make recognition somatically and audibly overflow.
Growth and increase prevent the response from ending with the spoken sentence.
Lowering and submission identify the increasing inward-bodily state produced across the sequence.

structural_cues: 17:97 binds blindness, muteness, and deafness to faces; 17:107 and 17:109 place 17:108 between two nearly repeated falls upon the chins, then add weeping and increased humility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory closure and a later reception-fall-speech-fall-tears sequence; I infer that the focus utterance is its transforming hinge. A live alternative is that 17:108 is simply a quoted creed inserted between two descriptions of prostration.

changed_reading.before: The speakers state a proposition while their bodily response remains incidental.
changed_reading.after: Their saying is restored sensorium in action: heard truth becomes voiced praise, lowered faces, tears, and still-growing humility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invocation by divine names is bounded between excessive audibility and disappearing speech, then recast as seeking a traversable middle route; the focus 'they say' becomes a calibrated devotional performance.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying supplies the utterance whose manner is subsequently regulated.
Praise as prayer and worship places the utterance within devotional practice.
Calling and inclining by speech turn divine naming into addressed invocation.
Public declaration and raised sound supply one prohibited vocal extreme.
Secreted, lowered articulation supplies the opposite prohibited extreme.
Active seeking makes vocal calibration a deliberate practice rather than a compromise by accident.
A traversable extended road supplies the functional middle course for prayerful speech.

structural_cues: 17:110 permits alternate divine names, forbids both loudness and near-silence in prayer, and commands seeking a way between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invocation, two vocal limits, and a sought route; I infer that the focus saying is best heard as measured confession within prayer. The live alternative is that the vocal rule addresses the messenger's prayer only and does not characterize the quoted speakers.

changed_reading.before: The clause records only what content the speakers utter.
changed_reading.after: It also presents a mode of utterance: addressed, worshipful confession voiced along a deliberately measured path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command unfolds praise through denied offspring, denied partnership in sovereignty, denied need of a patron arising from abasement, and positive magnification; these negations specify what the focus transcendence formula clears from doubled Lordship.

activation_trace.role: Absolving from defect supplies the focus formula that the closing negations unpack.
Sovereignty and mastery, repeated around the promise, provide the authority being declared unshared.
Praise opposed to blame places the closing confession in the same doxological register.
Participation and shared possession supply the relation explicitly excluded from sovereignty.
Kingship and sovereign rule identify the domain in which partnership is denied.
Taking charge of an affair supplies the patronage the Lord is said not to require.
Abasement under compulsion supplies the weakness from which needed patronage is denied.
Greatness and majesty turn the cleared negations into positive magnification.

structural_cues: 17:111 closes with three coordinated negations concerning child, partner in rule, and patron from abasement, followed by an intensive command to magnify.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit denials and magnification; I infer that they semantically unpack 'glory to our Lord' and tie promise-fulfillment to unshared governance. The live alternative is that 17:111 is an independent closing formula rather than an expansion of the speakers' words.

changed_reading.before: The transcendence formula is general praise or amazement at fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: It is a precise confession that the promise manifests sovereignty without offspring, co-ruler, dependency, or compelled weakness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it couples form-distant motion branches from the focus with descent and falling in context. It remains inspectably anchored in the packet's branches for focus words 2 and 6 and in the immediate bodily sequence; downstream prose should render it only as a kinetic resonance, never as the lexical gloss of either focus word or as an exclusive interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 2 and 6 place transcendence-language and promise in the same clause before the result-form at word 8.

activation_trace.role: Swimming, running, and coursing supply motion to the transcendence-formula as an exploratory image.
The non-dominant mapped branch of swimming or flowing travel makes the promise itself appear to traverse a course.
Produced action gives the exploratory course an effected endpoint in the focus.
Caused descent and conveyance supply a directed contextual trajectory toward reception.
A sounding fall carries the trajectory from recited delivery into the body before the focus saying.
The repeated fall resumes the trajectory after the saying and prevents it from reading as static.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a static proposition later stamped fulfilled.
changed_reading.after: As a contained kinetic resonance, it courses from descent into receptive bodies and arrives as enacted praise, prostration, and effect.

strongest_changes: The bones-and-fragments dispute makes promise-fulfillment materially operative as renewed creation.
The Pharaoh-to-gathering sequence turns fulfillment into a reversal of displacement at an appointed time.
Gradual, truth-framed descent permits fulfillment to be distributed across paced stages.
The placement between two falls transforms saying into the hinge of restored hearing, speech, posture, tears, and humility.
The final praise formula specifies transcendence as unshared and non-dependent sovereignty.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled 'our Lord' and the passive-result 'made-done' let one short utterance bind governance, appointment, material efficacy, historical reversal, staged delivery, and embodied reception without forcing those mechanisms into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus promise may narrow to resurrection, the final gathering, revelation's staged realization, or deliberately remain capacious across them.
The temporal force of 'was' may mark realized occurrence, enduring certainty, or rhetorical projection of the future as complete.
The scarcity contrast is a contextual economic analogy, while the kinetic course is intentionally retained only as branch-backed exploratory resonance.
